documentation.content:
Reference: https://jira.ngage.netapp.com/browse/NFSAAS-150189 

Runbook: Cluster Object Store Maximum Limit Reached
This runbook provides steps to debug and fix the error: "FAILED - Cannot create object store configuration as the number of object stores in the cluster has reached maximum allowed limit of 2000" when an alert is received.

Please follow the COPS: https://jira.ngage.netapp.com/browse/COPS-73555
1. Alert Triage and Validation
Acknowledge the alert.
Verify the exact error message to confirm it is related to the object store limit of 2000.
Check the cluster's current object store count. The count should be 2000 or near the limit.
Identify the component or job that attempted the creation and failed.
2. Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
The core issue is a hard limit of 2000 object stores per cluster. Determine if this is an expected scale issue or a cleanup issue.
Scenario A: Expected Growth (Needs Cluster Expansion/Migration)
The service legitimately requires more than 2000 object stores.

Review cluster capacity planning to see if this scale was anticipated.
Consult the Engineering team and SREs to discuss options for cluster expansion, sharding, or migration to a higher-capacity platform.
Scenario B: Unnecessary/Stale Object Stores (Needs Cleanup)
Object stores are being created but not properly cleaned up.

Review object store creation logs for the last 30d to look for rapid or repeated creation patterns by a specific service or user.
Identify stale or unused object stores, specifically those not accessed or used in the last 90 days.
